incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated RPM on model family mariner8b (us-east). 5m spike, ~3x baseline. Tail latency rising. Auto-scaling healthy but errors creeping. Paging @Aisha
Aisha: Acknowledged — I'm oncall. @Rohan any customer-facing errors or just latency?
Rohan: Seeing stream session 429s + some 5xxs from downstream transforms. 5 customers with retries, mostly long prompts causing bursty token churn.
Devon: Propose soft-throttle: drop per-model RPM to 30, disable funcall for mariner8b (funcalls are producing big payloads). Avoid hard cut to prevent mass client retries.
Aisha: OK. Follow runbook step 2: apply per-model RPM change, tag with incident id inc-1745020000. @Rohan can you apply and paste the command here?
Rohan: Running now — applying soft throttle and toggling feature off:
```bash
./opsctl rate update --model mariner8b --rpm 30 --tag inc-1745020000
./opsctl feature toggle --model mariner8b --feature funcall --state off --tag inc-1745020000
```
Monitoring metrics after deploy.
Marcy: Notifying the 5 affected customers via support (short note + ETA). Updating status page: investigating elevated requests on mariner8b.
Rohan: Changes applied. RPM: 30 (env us-east), funcall disabled. Preliminary metrics: 95p latency down ~40%, 429s down ~70%. Error volume not zero but dropping.
Aisha: Good. Keep tenant burst for enterprise at 2x for now to avoid customer breakage. Keep this thread pinned for 30m and re-eval. @Devon please prepare canary rollback (steps + validation queries).
Devon: Canary rollback ready: increase RPM to 50 for canary tenants, re-enable funcall for <=1% traffic, validate 95/99 latencies and error rate for 10m before ramp.
sre-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: inc-1745020000 — mariner8b RPM set to 30; funcall feature disabled.
Aisha: Thanks. Marcy, post status update after 10m if metrics look stable. I'll hand off to next oncall in 30m. If any customer escalations, @Rohan will coordinate.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by Aisha. Incident remains open until manual close.
Aisha: Closing loop here for now — monitoring continues. Will update when we restore funcalls and raise RPM. :thumbsup:
